examples.description: Generate footage for a planned scene

description: [$0.10/sec at provider cost] Generate video for a scene from its prompt (text-to-video). Pass scene_id to fill a planned scene, or prompt to create-and-generate in one step. NEVER mention camera equipment (crane, dolly, rig) — describe what to SHOW. Say 'camera rises' NOT 'crane shot'. Include: subject, action, lighting, color palette, mood.

project_id.description: The studio project (vp_…) this tool acts on.

prompt.description: Visual description; required when scene_id is omitted.

style.description: Visual style: cinematic, corporate, playful, dramatic

name: studio.generate_scene
